property.name: pricebookId
property.label: Pricebook Id
property.description: Id of the Quote's active pricebook. Input and output - updated if user changes pricebook.

property.name: accountId
property.label: Account Id
property.description: Quote's Account Id - used to filter available pricebooks to account-specific approved custom pricebooks.

property.name: quoteId
property.label: Quote Id
property.description: The Quote record Id - used to update Quote.Pricebook2Id when the user changes pricebook.

property.name: currencyIsoCode
property.label: Currency ISO Code
property.description: Quote's currency (e.g. USD, JPY) - filters PricebookEntries to matching currency only.

property.name: invoiceFrequency
property.label: Invoice Frequency
property.description: Quote's Invoice Frequency - filters products to those matching this frequency.

property.name: value
property.label: Selected Product IDs
property.description: Semicolon-delimited Product2 IDs selected by the user.

property.name: mode
property.label: Mode
property.description: Output: customPricebook when user chose the custom pricebook path; empty for standard Add to Quote.

property.name: attributeMap
property.label: Attribute Map JSON
property.description: JSON map of Product2Id to selected attribute value for products with configurable attributes.
